lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Arranged in distinct vertical columns of circular high-luminance blobs, increasing in diameter and spatial separation posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Primary vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the lateral blobs, forming a structured grid-like lattice across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature on the upper third of the flank exhibiting a sharp luminance transition, with high-intensity pixels along the dorsal edge and a shadow gradient below.

other_distinctive_markers: Dense, high-frequency clustering of small, circular high-luminance spots on the cranial region and the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin.
